description: Publishes a Shutters member's public photos on a hostname they own: a CNAME to customers.shutte.rs, a TXT record that proves they own the hostname, and the _acme-challenge CNAME that lets Cloudflare issue and renew its certificate (delegated DCV).
variableDescription: %token%: a short-lived ownership token Shutters generates for the member's pending hostname; Shutters checks it in this TXT record itself
